META_NOTES.ring_note: a ring row is sampled inside EveryOneMinute before the mod's queue drains that minute: row k reads the state drain k-1 left, so its writer inputs are drain k-1's, taken at about row k-1's world age
META_NOTES.set_note: record.set writes into the in-memory record only (H6); the entries reach the slot file at the next store step
META_NOTES.spawn_note: the foods are spawned by RCON additem and confirmed by the server's item.get id (ruling T2-11)
META_NOTES.eat_note: a networked eat ends in real time, 232 x 20 ms, whatever the clock (#3766)
META_NOTES.frame_note: no frame window is graded in this session (no tick.ring), so no drop_windows apply

FOOD.item.get after the spawn: an id for TKX.Mono450, TKX.Mixed400 and TKX.Unit50, none before
FOOD.falsifier: an id missing on a live bus

EATS.every eat: spawned found and landed; both entries exist after

SET.record.set: ok, after equal to the value sent within 1e-9; the entries read back equal
SET.falsifier: a reply not ok or a value off

PANIC.the writer's PANIC input: <= 5.0 on every row from the sets to the end of EDGE (#3691)
PANIC.falsifier: a row over it (EDGE_STATS's BOREDOM half then void)

EDGE_TARGET.writer boredTarget: the kernel's target at the previous row's age within TGT_TOL; its change at the edge rows no larger than the window's largest other change + TGT_TOL
EDGE_TARGET.unmeasured: fewer than EDGE_PRE_ROWS clean rows (a game minute past the sets' age_after) before the edge, the ring not covering it, or the key-count premise unread or off

EDGE_STATS.UNHAPPINESS and BOREDOM: the change at the edge rows <= the largest change on the neighbour rows + 0.1

PRUNE.after: TKX.Mono450 kept with n and last unchanged, TKX.Mixed400 gone
PRUNE.void: the Unit50 eat did not land

Z.players: answers a list (the server alive at the end)

deviations: Pre-run edit after the Opus review of f099c44a: the sets run on a nearly stopped clock (time.multiplier SET_MULT, restored in a finally) and EDGE_LEAD_H is 0.2 h, so last is T - 167.8 h, not the run sheet's 167.9 h.
Pre-run edit: the graded edge window starts a game minute past SET's age_after (clean rows), and EDGE_TARGET and EDGE_STATS read unmeasured unless EDGE_PRE_ROWS clean rows precede the edge.
Pre-run edit: EDGE_TARGET reads unmeasured when neither monotony.t key count was read.
